description: This file defines functions and constants for handling account snapshot fields related to credential statuses and safe channel account snapshots, including utility functions for reading and projecting specific account fields.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> or null if invalid.

methods.name: readTrimmedString
methods.description: Reads a string value from a record and trims whitespace, returning undefined if empty.

methods.name: readBoolean
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from a record.

methods.name: readNumber
methods.description: Reads a finite number from a record.

methods.name: readStringArray
methods.description: Reads an array of strings from a record, normalizing and filtering.

methods.name: readCredentialStatus
methods.description: Reads a credential status value, ensuring it is one of the allowed strings.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredFromCredentialStatuses
methods.description: Determines if account credentials are configured based on status keys.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredFromRequiredCredentialStatuses
methods.description: Checks if required credential statuses indicate configuration.

methods.name: hasConfiguredUnavailableCredentialStatus
methods.description: Checks if any credential status is 'configured_unavailable'.

methods.name: hasResolvedCredentialValue
methods.description: Checks if account has a resolved credential value or available status.

methods.name: projectCredentialSnapshotFields
methods.description: Projects credential-related fields from an account into a snapshot object.

methods.name: projectSafeChannelAccountSnapshotFields
methods.description: Projects safe channel account snapshot fields from an account object.
